description: Use when you have coordinates in the Netherlands and need the address: nearest official BAG address with distance in metres, postcode, city, municipality, province, BAG ids and CBS buurt and wijk codes, plus other nearby addresses. Input: WGS84 latitude and longitude. Source: Kadaster BAG via PDOK. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402, or 1 credit of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed
